_meta.name: Sona BLW Precision Forgings Ltd (Sona Comstar)
_meta.basis: Consolidated, Rs crore unless stated. Company revenue includes net forex gain (Screener books it in other income), so company revenue/EBITDA run ~0.5% above Screener's.

denso.what: Board outcome: EV-business slump sale, DENSO share subscription, JV2

screener.what: Screener consolidated financials (frozen at as-of by the engine)

business.what: Designs and makes driveline and motor products for vehicles: differential gears and assemblies (incl. EV differentials), intermediate gears, epicyclic gear trains, steering bevel boxes; conventional and micro-hybrid starter motors; EV traction motors and controllers (2W/3W), EV suspension motors (with ClearMotion), plus railway brakes, couplers and suspension (bought from Escorts Kubota, Jun-2025) and radar sensors (NOVELIC, Serbia). Single reportable segment ('Mobility components, systems and sub-systems').
business.plants: 12 plants (India: Gurugram, Manesar, Faridabad, Pune, Chennai; US; Mexico x2; China; Serbia R&D), 5 R&D centres, 3 engineering centres
business.customers: 7 of the world's top-10 PV OEMs, 3 of top-10 CV, 7 of top-10 tractor makers, 3 of top-10 EV OEMs
business.productsCount: 29 products at FY26 (10 five years earlier); railway added 4; 3 added in FY26 (hydraulic motor controller, HVAC, electric panels)

mix._note: Company pie charts; product-level revenue is not disclosed ('we don't report segment-wise or BU-wise revenue', CEO, Q3FY26 call).

powertrain._order: BEV, micro-hybrid/hybrid, power-source neutral, ICE-dependent (% of automotive product revenue)

mix.topProducts: Top four products were 86% of revenue in FY25; in FY26 the same 86% came from the top eight (ar26 CEO letter)
mix.tractionMotorShare: 'almost 10% of our revenue now' (CEO, Q4FY26 call, May-2026); lowest-margin product line
mix.src: ar26 p.40-41; q4ppt slide 16; q1call p.9; q4call p.16

bev.programs: 69 EV programmes across 36 customers at Q1FY27 (67/35 at Q4FY26)
bev.fy26Story: Q1FY26 hit by weakness in one anchor customer's model (US), China's rare-earth magnet export curbs, a change in supply terms with one European customer and US tariffs; US BEV industry sales -16% in FY26; BEV revenue -5.6% for the year, then a record Q4 (ar26 CEO letter)
bev.src: q1ppt slide 34; q4ppt slides 9, 20; q2call p.5; q3call p.6

orderBook.definition: Net order book = revenue from awarded programmes not yet in production or not fully ramped, over the next 10 years, net of phase-outs and discounted for delays; railway = POs for ~12 months

q1fy27.drivers: Margin hit by input-cost inflation (April tough, May tougher, June better as pass-through caught up), labour cost and a mix shift to lower-margin traction motors; India PV and e-2W strong, Europe growing, US better, China mixed but fastest-growing for Sona (suspension motors). Best quarter for operating cash flow (lower debtor days). Net debt negative.

fy26.src: q4ppt slides 6, 20-22; q4call pp.7-8; ar26 p.74-75 (MD&A)

guidance.margin: EBITDA margin band 23-25% after the railway acquisition (24-26% for the core business before it; 25-27% at IPO). CEO, Q4FY26 call, May-2026. Not changed on the Q1FY27 call.
guidance.growth: No annual revenue guidance. 'Sona Comstar 2.0' ambition (Jul-2026): another 10x in a decade (FY25 revenue Rs3,555 cr).
guidance.newBusinesses: 'If your investment horizon is less than 3 years, none of this [robotics, eVTOL] has any meaning for you as an investor' (CEO, Q4FY26 call). Robotics & Physical AI order book Rs800 cr; first SOPs within 12-15 months.
guidance.costs: Commodity inflation (steel, aluminium, copper, freight, energy) and Haryana minimum wage rise from 1-Apr-2026 to pressure margins; pass-through lags (Q4FY26 call).

corporateActions.what: Sona BLW acquired Comstar Automotive Technologies (starter motors, alternators); Singapore VII Topco III, the erstwhile holding company and an earlier promoter, has since exited; the two merged into the listed entity
Listed on NSE/BSE (IPO; the then holding company Singapore VII Topco III later exited, AR FY26 ERI-plan note). First weekly close on Screener Rs364.7 (25-Jun-2021)
QIP: Rs2,400 cr, 3.48 cr shares (~5.6% dilution) at ~Rs690; net Rs2,369.5 cr
Majority stake in NOVELIC (Serbia; mmWave radar, perception software); last tranche paid in FY26
Acquired the Railway Equipment Division of Escorts Kubota by slump sale for Rs1,642.6 cr (agreed Oct-2024; FY25 revenue under Escorts Rs912.8 cr): brakes, couplers, suspension; goodwill recognised
corporateActions.src: ar26 MD&A p.75, auditor KAM; ar25 p.18

corporateActions.what: DENSO deals: (1) 2W/3W EV business (air-cooled traction motors, inverters, e-axles; FY26 turnover Rs385.5 cr, net worth Rs347.1 cr) slump-sold to subsidiary Sona eDrive for Rs893.2 cr (Rs857.5 cr cash + shares); DENSO subscribes 49% of Sona eDrive at an enterprise value of Rs1,750 cr, Sona keeps 51% and control; completion on or before 31-Mar-2027. (2) JV2 for liquid-cooled HV traction motors/inverters for 4W+: DENSO 51%, Sona 49% (Rs26.2 cr of Rs53.5 cr initial capital). Royalties both ways.

management.name: Vivek Vikram Singh
management.role: MD & Group CEO (with the company since 2016; ran the IPO)
management.pay: Rs149.6 mn in FY26, 144x the median employee, +15%

management.name: Priya Sachdev Kapur
management.role: Non-executive, non-independent director from 23-Jun-2025 (Aureus Investment's nominee); added to the Audit Committee 22-Jul-2026

governance.board: 9 directors at Mar-2026: 6 independent (2 women), 2 executive, 1 promoter nominee. Statutory auditor Walker Chandiok & Co LLP.
governance.promoterEvents: Chairman Sunjay Kapur died on 12-Jun-2025. His mother Rani Kapur wrote before the 25-Jul-2025 AGM claiming to be the majority shareholder of the group and asking for the AGM to be postponed; the company called the claims baseless (no shareholding since 2019, when Sunjay Kapur was declared sole beneficial owner of the RK Family Trust behind Aureus) and sent a cease-and-desist notice (Outlook Business, 29-Jul-2025). A family dispute over Aureus continued into 2026 (Mint, Feb-2026). The listed company is professionally run; the promoter holds one board seat.
governance.eri: Singapore VII Topco III (the erstwhile holding company) paid exit-return cash rewards to some employees and KMP, without recourse to the company
governance.src: ar26 board report pp.82-83, corporate governance report; https://www.outlookbusiness.com/explainers/rani-kapur-vs-sona-comstar-will-the-dispute-over-family-representation-reach-court

otherIncomeFY26.note: Screener split. Treasury income fell as Rs1,800 cr went into the railway purchase, land (~Rs110 cr) and NOVELIC; company: 'lower net finance income' cut PAT margin ~3.4 pts in Q4FY26. Forex gain on revenue sits in Screener's other income (company revenue Rs4,475 cr vs Screener Rs4,449 cr).

capexFY26.note: No capex guidance; EV/motor capex is light (Rs8-12 of revenue per Rs1 of capex, Q1FY27 call)
